description: Search the store catalog of gift cards, service top-ups and eSIM data plans. Returns matching products with their price, availability and product page URL.

country.description: ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code the product is issued for, e.g. US, TR.

query.description: Free text matched against product name and brand, e.g. "steam" or "playstation".

type.description: voucher = gift card, recharge_fixed / recharge = top-up, e_sim = eSIM data plan.

name: search_catalog
